blocks.text: Riverbend keeps a perpetual inventory. Every sale records the revenue and, in the same entry, the cost of the goods that left. The selling price is on the invoice; the cost is here.
A stock card is kept for the items marked above. Freight paid on goods bought FOB shipping point is part of what the inventory cost, not a separate expense.

items: FICA is withheld at 7.65 per cent of gross pay, and the company owes the same amount again as its own expense.
Amounts withheld from employees are liabilities until they are remitted; the company's own share is Payroll Tax Expense. Keeping those apart is the single most common payroll error.
No federal or state unemployment tax is due in December: every employee passed the wage base earlier in the year.
